_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: O n ṣere Gọọfu (Awọn ere Kaadi) - Player {player_id}. Goal: Gba awọn ti o kere lapapọ score ni yi nikan yika. Ti o ba ti ọwọn pin awọn kanna iye, ti won ti wa ni summed bi 0. Kaadi iye: A = 1, 2-10 = oju iye, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Actions (lo gangan brackets): - '[draw]' - Fa lati dekini - '[take]' - Ya lati egbin discard - '[swap X Y]' - Swap fa kaadi pẹlu ipo X (row) Y (column) - '[discard]' - Fi awọn kaadi fa

board.drew: O fa: {card} Bayi o gbọdọ [swap X Y] tabi [discard] o.
board.took: O gba: {card} lati inu àpò ìyọnu O gbọdọ [swap X Y] pẹlu rẹ (kò le ṣe ìyọnu).

options.final_turns: Ìyí ìkẹyìn! Àwọn àyè rẹ: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: O gbọdọ: [swap X Y] (kò lè fi kaadi sílẹ̀ láti inú àpò ìyókù)

action_desc.swapped: Ẹ̀yà orin {pid} pààrọ̀ {new} pẹ̀lú {old} ní ipò ({row},{col})

message.knocked: Ẹnìkan {pid} ti kọlu! Ẹnìkan yòókù gba ìyíkan síi.
message.final_round: Oṣere {pid} {reason}! Ọkọọkan oṣere mìíràn rí iye ìgbà kan sì.

reason.all_revealed: ṣé gbogbo káàdì tó wà nínú rẹ̀ ló ti hàn?

invalid.wrong_action: Lo gangan ỌKAN ti a fi si abẹlẹ: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], tabi [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kò sí nǹkan kan nínú àpò ìdọ̀tí náà!
invalid.must_draw_first: O gbọdọ kọkọ [draw], [take], [knock], tabi [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: O ko le ta kaadi ti o gba lati inu akojopo awon kaadi ti a ta sile. O gbodo yi i.
invalid.have_drawn_card: O ní káàdì tí a fà. O ní láti [swap X Y] tàbí [discard] ó.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: O nílò káàdì tí wọ́n fà láti fi pààrọ̀.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: O nílò káàdì tí wọ́n fà láti fi sọ nù.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Ipo ti o wa ni ita awọn aala. Lo ila 1-{max_row}, ọwọn 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: O ko le lu ija pẹlu kaadi ti o gba. Ṣe pari igo rẹ kọjọ kojọ.
invalid.already_knocked: Ẹnì kan ti já bọ́ọ̀lù yìí.
invalid.already_revealed: A ti ṣí káàdì yẹn payá!
